title: athyrium filix-femina proles acrostichoideum
intro: Athyrium filix-femina proles acrostichoideum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. It is a perennial plant known for its delicate, lacy fronds and is native to Europe, Asia, and North America. The health benefits of Lady fern include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be used to treat various health issues such as wounds, eczema, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Lady fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
